name: tsugi
displayName: Tsugi - Copilot Chat Context Window & Handoff
description: Live Copilot Chat context window and token counter with a bilingual sidebar for credit budgets, handoff detail, and automatic fresh-chat handoffs.

tsugi.language.description: Language used by the Tsugi sidebar.

tsugi.nextChatCredits.description: Suggested AI credit budget for the next chat. Included in the handoff prompt; it does not enforce a hard VS Code billing limit.

tsugi.handoffMode.description: Amount of context included in the next-chat handoff.

tsugi.autoOpenNewChat.description: Automatically open a new chat when handing off the current chat.

tsugi.saveHandoff.description: Save a copy of the handoff prompt to extension storage.

tsugi.warnPercent.description: Usage percentage at which the status bar changes to a warning color.

tsugi.baseOverheadTokens.description: Additional system and MCP overhead to add when Copilot's saved token details do not include it. Keep at 0 when the saved prompt total already includes tool definitions.
